ACK_rule: Each root+phase ACK requires every listed recipient accepted the exact token/context/version/epoch payload AND old source/replay/consumer returns quiescent; a single load_v does not certify aggregate completion.

missing_output_semantics.accepted_load: Requires registered pulse/tag matching exact actual store write (rst_n&&!clear&&load_v at load edge); currently inputs only, no output ACK.
missing_output_semantics.response_capture: Requires registered exact request/context tag at coherent core response edge; this is cache capture, not arithmetic retirement.
missing_output_semantics.epoch_quiescent: Requires source/transport/cache responses and old core request/pipeline drained; neither core_ready nor cache_hit certify this. Production u_me idle currently discarded; whole-frame aggregation absent.
